designationHistory.name: Santa Rosa and San Jacinto Mountains National Monument
designationHistory.indexText: The Santa Rosa and San Jacinto Mountains National Monument Act of 2000 designated the national monument in California.
designationHistory.note: Established by statute, not under the Antiquities Act; jointly managed by the BLM and the Forest Service.
